key_point: Diablo was almost a completely different game
title: Diablo was almost a completely different game
caption: Diablo was designed as a slow, turn-based game. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #diablo #blizzard

instagram.caption:
Diablo was first planned as a turn-based game, like the roguelikes its creators loved.

Blizzard wanted real time. David Brevik reluctantly changed the code in a single afternoon, clicked the mouse, and his warrior walked to the spot instantly.

He said he knew right then they had something special. A whole genre came out of that click.

Would Diablo still be Diablo as turn-based?
